banking.captureStory: {{cast.personName}} asks {{cast.agentId}} to check a balance. The agent exchanges the person's token for its own delegated token (RFC 8693, sub kept, act added). The downstream API accepts the delegated token and refuses the person's original one.

healthcare.captureStory: {{cast.personName}} asks {{cast.agentId}} to read an appointment list. The delegated token carries act, so the audit trail shows who acted for whom. The person's raw token is refused downstream.

retail.captureStory: {{cast.personName}} asks {{cast.agentId}} to pull an order history. Aud/scope are narrowed on the delegated token: the agent can only do what this one call needs, on this one API.
